name_reason: Follows the CRT-wrapper convention crt_equivalent_*; descriptor get_eflags accurately reflects the body (PUSHFD; POP EAX captures EFLAGS into EAX). No Ghidra address residue in the name. The CLI side effect is a Watcom _disable semantic and is documented in the comment; the name need not encode it. Correct as-is.
purpose: 4-byte Watcom _disable primitive: atomically capture the current EFLAGS into EAX and disable interrupts (clear IF), used by AIL ISRs to enter a critical section.
logic_summary: Body is PUSHFD; POP EAX; CLI; RET. PUSHFD pushes the EFLAGS image and POP EAX returns it in EAX (prior interrupt/flag state); CLI clears IF as a side effect so the caller runs in a critical section. The Ghidra decompiler renders PUSHFD;POP EAX as an explicit per-bit EFLAGS reassembly expression and cannot represent CLI; the 4-instruction disassembly is authoritative. No callees, no globals, single basic block, cyclomatic complexity 1. In src it is emitted via the shared #pragma aux helper crt_capture_eflags_cli (pushfd/pop eax/cli) which the optimiser inlines, yielding the exact 4-byte body.

returns.semantics: The prior EFLAGS image captured by PUSHFD;POP EAX (returned in EAX). Callers (via the thunk) save it and later restore it with PUSH+POPFD on critical-section exit.

comment_original_issue: Comment content was accurate and precise, but contained three em-dash (U+2014) characters (lines 445, 449, 452) violating the project ASCII-only rule for code comments; converted to '--'. No semantic change.
notes: Reached only via crt_equivalent_get_eflags_thunk @ 0x37f86 (UNCONDITIONAL_JUMP); zero direct callers. Owns its own PUBDEF so the thunk's JMP target resolves to a real symbol. Ghidra plate is consistent with the refined src understanding, so it was left unchanged (ghidra_plate_action=none). Only src comment characters were edited; no logic/type/signature/symbol-name changes (per refiner rules). commit_hash filled in by the commit step below.
